theme: Graphite backend preview and Vulkan packaging
highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews Graphite GPU bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, plus a new Vulkan Silk.NET package.
highlights_body: Alongside the Graphite preview, this release ships backend-neutral async pixel reads, several native use-after-free and leak fixes, more managed-side performance ports, and Skia m151/m152 servicing syncs.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled Skia engine to m152, with several m151/m152 servicing syncs and upstream stability fixes merged along the way.
Adds Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, giving early access to Skia's next-generation GPU backend.

bullets.lead: Vulkan Silk.NET package and backend-neutral async reads
bullets.detail: Adds a SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package (restoring production of the Vulkan Silk.NET package) and a backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels API on SKImage and SKSurface.

bullets.lead: Improved NuGet READMEs and Apple symbol packages
bullets.detail: Improves NuGet package READMEs and generates Apple native symbol packages during packing.

Fixes native use-after-free bugs in SKRegion.SpanIterator and SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With* by rooting the underlying native source, fixes a CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak on the SKImage.Create raster failure path, and fixes an undisposed SKStreamAsset leak in the HarfBuzz blob conversion path.

bullets.lead: Runtime effect uniform buffer and Font.Shape fixes
bullets.detail: Disposes the previous uniform buffer in SKRuntimeEffectUniforms.Reset() to avoid leaking it, and avoids a defensive Feature[] copy in Font.Shape.

Removes char boxing in SKFourByteTag/Tag ToString, avoids an intermediate string allocation in GetEncodedText's null-terminated path, pre-sizes the SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map, and caches a HandleDictionary skip-registration reflection check.
Makes binding generation deterministic across platforms, and requires deterministic Android symbol identity for reproducible builds.

bullets.lead: New containerized test legs and Nano Server font support
bullets.detail: Adds containerized test legs for Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server, and uses FreeType for font support on Nano Server.
Stops pinning a default Windows SDK version and initializes the MSVC environment once per native build.
Converts all .sln solution files to the newer .slnx format.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-based font support for Nano Server
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Added Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Bumped the externals/skia submodule to drop the SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM redefinition

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the 4.152.0 line with the Graphite GPU backend preview, the Vulkan Silk.NET package, and the Skia m151/m152 servicing syncs.

harfbuzz_summary: Bumps the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1.200 and avoids a defensive Feature[] copy in Font.Shape.
